purpose: Independent PRESS-equivalent review of every evidence-derived logical search family before seed-recall validation and search-frame freezing.

review_scope.concepts_complete: The family-specific evidence terms, paper-object block, and measurement, prediction, or validation context jointly retrieve the intended construct and evidence role without an evident source-supported omission.
review_scope.boolean_logic_valid: Parentheses, OR blocks, AND relationships, and logical scope are valid and preserve the intended three-block structure.
review_scope.spelling_valid: Terms contain no accidental spelling error. A source-attested historical spelling is not an error and must be explained if retained.
review_scope.phrases_valid: Multiword phrases and variants are quoted or grouped appropriately, without changing the source-supported construct.
review_scope.limits_justified: The common publication-date and eligible-work-type filters match the frozen protocol; English eligibility is applied during screening rather than retrieval so non-English records remain in the denominator.
review_scope.evidence_check: Use term_evidence_json to verify that every logical family has direct English source support and that pilot-only hints do not independently authorize a family.
review_scope.redundancy_check: Archive only if another logical query completely covers the same semantics, the current family has no independent construct or evidence role, and logical coverage is explicit. Result-set subset coverage is subsequently recomputed by the pipeline.

decision_rules.pass: All five PRESS checklist fields are true; covered_by_logical_query_id is blank; independent_construct_role is true; notes identify the construct/evidence role and any material ambiguity checked.
decision_rules.revise: At least one checklist field is false or a source-supported concept/term is missing; notes state the exact defect and proposed correction.
decision_rules.archive_redundant: covered_by_logical_query_id names a different active logical query; logical_coverage_verified is true; independent_construct_role is false; notes explain complete semantic coverage. result_set_coverage_verified remains false until pipeline validation.
